settings.autoQuarantineHint: AES-256-GCM quarantine; files can always be restored.
settings.autoResumeHint: A scan interrupted by a restart continues from the next file.
settings.canaryPathsHint: Empty = engine defaults in Documents and Desktop
settings.closeToTrayHint: Closing the window keeps MI CS in the tray and its engine running. Off (the default): closing the window quits MI CS, and the engine it started stops with it.
settings.scanHoursHint: The engine scans by itself this often; it has to be running (logon entry or the app), and a scheduled run reports without quarantining.
settings.diagnosticsHint: Reports the engine wrote for a panic, a run that never said goodbye, or a hang. The bug id is what support needs, and nothing here is sent anywhere.
settings.explorerMenu: Add to the Explorer right-click menu
settings.explorerMenuHint: Adds «Scan this file with MI CS» and «Scan this folder with MI CS» to the right-click menu, for your Windows account only. Turning it off removes them.
settings.guardAutostart: Start the process guard with the engine
settings.guardAutostartHint: Real-time process monitoring starts with the engine; it outlives the window only when «Keep running in the background» is on.
settings.iocFeedHint: The public abuse.ch exports now require an Auth-Key. Leave the URL empty to skip the hash blocklist; domains and CISA KEV keep syncing either way.
settings.languageMissing: The engine's settings store the language «{tag}», and this build ships no pack for it, so MI CS is showing English. Choosing a language above replaces it.
settings.languagePackMissing: This build does not carry the pack for {language}, so its keys show English or their own names. A repair install replaces this copy.
settings.manifestUrlDefault: empty = MI CS' own release feed
settings.soundsHint: A short cue per severity; muted automatically in DND.
settings.subtitle: Everything here is stored by the engine in settings.json — the UI and the protection engine always agree.
settings.title: Settings
settings.toastsHint: A card above the taskbar for every security event: a caught virus, an attack, or protection that acted. Do-not-disturb silences everything below CRITICAL.
settings.manifestHint: Leave it empty to read MI CS' own release feed for the channel you pick. Nothing is fetched until you press Check now.
diagnostics.openFailed: The report could not be opened
diagnostics.copied: Report copied — the bug id is the first line
settings.integrityOk: Signed by MI CS, and every file matches the manifest.
settings.integrityUntrusted: Signed by MI CS and every file matches; this Windows does not trust the release certificate yet (self-signed build).
settings.integrityUnverified: Not the published build: the signed manifest inside the engine disagrees with these files. Download MI CS again from the official source.
